Okie Pet Rescue is a 501(c)3 non-profit organization. We are a foster based animal rescue and are located in Oklahoma. We strive to be the difference we wish to see in our community. You can help us on our mission to save neglected, abused, stray, homeless, and unwanted animals by donating and by spaying and neutering your pets.
Listed below are links to make a Venmo donation, make a PayPal donation, our adoption application, and our Amazon Wish List. You can also check out our Facebook page and website to see all of our adoptable pets. Please share this channel so more people can see our adoptable pets. Thank you in advance!
Our email is: okiepetrescue@gmail.com
